title.fr: Focométrie : détermination de la distance focale d'une lentille

sketch:
Observe: SVG bench with unknown-f' convergente, object AB at fixed
p, movable screen. Student slides screen until image is sharp (a
"sharpness bar" derived from computed p' vs. screen distance peaks
when they match). HUD reads measured p and p'; formula panel
computes f' via 1/p' − 1/p = 1/f'. Experiment: 3 seeded hidden f'
values; student measures each via the sharp-screen protocol.
Evaluate: no sharpness bar; student must estimate focus from a
blurred image rendering (Canvas 2D convolution proxy) and submit
measured f'.
